items.title: Trump’s Board of Peace chides Israel for ‘insufficient’ response to Gaza flooding
items.brief: US President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace urged Israel to allow essential aid into Gaza, after calling its response to massive weekend flooding across the shattered enclave “insufficient.”

items.title: Ex-officer convicted of killing Sandra Birchmore to keep Massachusetts woman quiet about sex abuse
items.brief: A former police detective was convicted Tuesday of murdering a pregnant Massachusetts woman, Sandra Birchmore, to keep her from revealing that he had sexually abused her when she was 15.

items.title: US Army soldier arrested in UK on suspicion of espionage related to Russia
items.brief: A 41-year-old United States Army soldier was arrested in the United Kingdom on Tuesday on suspicion of espionage related to Russia, according to London’s Metropolitan Police.
